name: Eggs
usdaDescription: Egg, whole, raw, fresh
nutritionNote: Whole fresh egg. Egg size and edible yield are package assumptions.

name: Milk (2%)
usdaDescription: Milk, reduced fat, fluid, 2% milkfat, with added vitamin A and vitamin D
nutritionNote: Generic 2% milk with vitamins A and D; brand fortification can differ.

name: Block cheese (cheddar)
usdaDescription: Cheese, cheddar (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
nutritionNote: Cheddar is the nutrition reference for the broader block-cheese price category.

name: Plain yogurt
usdaDescription: Yogurt, plain, low fat
nutritionNote: Plain low-fat yogurt. Flavoured or Greek yogurt needs a different record.

name: Chicken drumsticks
usdaDescription: Chicken, broilers or fryers, drumstick, meat and skin, raw
basis: Raw edible meat and skin; bones excluded
nutritionNote: Drumstick meat and skin. The 70% edible yield is a model assumption.

name: Chicken breasts
usdaDescription: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw
nutritionNote: Boneless, skinless chicken breast; no added solution.

name: Whole chicken
usdaDescription: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, raw
basis: Raw edible meat and skin; bones excluded
nutritionNote: Whole broiler/fryer meat and skin. The 68% edible yield is a model assumption.

name: Ground beef
usdaDescription: Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, raw
nutritionNote: Representative ground beef: 80% lean / 20% fat. The national price covers ground beef broadly.

name: Pork shoulder
usdaDescription: Pork, fresh, shoulder, whole, separable lean and fat, raw
basis: Raw edible lean and fat; bones excluded
nutritionNote: Whole shoulder, separable lean and fat. Package yield is a separate model assumption.

name: Pork loin
usdaDescription: Pork, fresh, loin, whole, separable lean and fat, raw
nutritionNote: Generic pork loin, separable lean and fat. The purchase unit assumes boneless meat.

name: Canned tuna (light, in water)
usdaDescription: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
nutritionNote: Light tuna in water, drained solids. The assumed drained yield is 70% of the can weight.

name: Canned salmon
usdaDescription: Fish, salmon, pink, canned, total can contents
nutritionNote: Pink salmon, total can contents, including edible bones.

name: Tofu (firm)
usdaDescription: Tofu, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride (nigari)
nutritionNote: Firm tofu set with calcium sulfate and magnesium chloride. Nutrition, especially calcium, varies by brand and coagulant.

name: Dried lentils
usdaDescription: Lentils, raw
nutritionNote: Raw dry lentils; do not enter cooked weights.

name: Dry beans (black)
usdaDescription: Beans, black, mature seeds, raw
nutritionNote: Dry black beans represent the broader beans-and-legumes price category.

name: Canned beans/lentils
usdaDescription: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, canned, drained solids
nutritionNote: Red kidney beans, drained solids, represent the broader canned-beans-and-lentils price category. The 60% drained yield is a model assumption.

name: Canned baked beans
usdaDescription: Beans, baked, canned, plain or vegetarian
nutritionNote: Plain or vegetarian baked beans; this reference excludes pork.

name: Peanut butter
usdaDescription: Peanut butter, smooth style, with salt (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
nutritionNote: Smooth peanut butter with salt. Check the label for added ingredients.

name: Peanuts (roasted)
usdaDescription: Peanuts, all types, dry-roasted, without salt
nutritionNote: Dry-roasted peanuts without salt. Salted products have different sodium values.

name: Sunflower seeds (kernels)
usdaDescription: Seeds, sunflower seed kernels, dry roasted, without salt
nutritionNote: Dry-roasted sunflower kernels without salt; pack weight assumes kernels, not in-shell seeds.

name: Soy milk (fortified)
usdaDescription: Soymilk, original and vanilla, with added calcium, vitamins A and D
nutritionNote: Original/vanilla soy milk with added calcium and vitamins A and D. Fortification and sugar vary by brand.

name: White rice
usdaDescription: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched
nutritionNote: Unenriched long-grain white rice; fortified or different rice varieties may differ.

name: Brown rice
usdaDescription: Rice, brown, long-grain, raw (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
nutritionNote: Raw long-grain brown rice.

name: Dry pasta
usdaDescription: Pasta, dry, enriched
nutritionNote: Dry enriched pasta is the nutrition reference; the national price category also includes fresh pasta.

name: Wheat flour (all-purpose)
usdaDescription: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached
nutritionNote: Enriched, unbleached all-purpose wheat flour.

name: White bread
usdaDescription: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)
nutritionNote: Commercially prepared white bread; sodium and fortification vary by product.

name: Rolled oats
usdaDescription: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry
nutritionNote: Regular/quick oats, dry and not fortified.

name: Bananas
usdaDescription: Bananas, raw
nutritionNote: Generic raw bananas.

name: Apples
usdaDescription: Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
basis: Raw edible fruit with skin; core excluded
nutritionNote: Raw apples with skin.

name: Oranges
usdaDescription: Oranges, raw, all commercial varieties
nutritionNote: Raw oranges, all commercial varieties.

name: Frozen strawberries
usdaDescription: Strawberries, frozen, unsweetened (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
nutritionNote: Unsweetened frozen strawberries.

name: Potatoes
usdaDescription: Potatoes, flesh and skin, raw
basis: Raw edible flesh and skin; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Raw potato flesh and skin. Discarded material is handled by the separate yield assumption.

name: Sweet potatoes
usdaDescription: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
basis: Raw edible weight; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Raw, unprepared sweet potato.

name: Carrots
usdaDescription: Carrots, raw
nutritionNote: Raw carrots.

name: Cabbage
usdaDescription: Cabbage, raw
nutritionNote: Raw cabbage.

name: Onions
usdaDescription: Onions, raw
nutritionNote: Raw onions.

name: Broccoli
usdaDescription: Broccoli, raw
nutritionNote: Raw broccoli. A 450 g head and 60% edible yield are model assumptions; the national price is per unit.

name: Peppers (bell)
usdaDescription: Peppers, sweet, red, raw
basis: Raw edible weight; seeds and stem excluded
nutritionNote: Red bell peppers represent the broader peppers price category; green peppers have different nutrient values.

name: Mushrooms
usdaDescription: Mushrooms, white, raw
nutritionNote: Raw white mushrooms.

name: Frozen mixed vegetables
usdaDescription: Vegetables, mixed, frozen, unprepared
basis: Frozen unprepared weight; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Generic frozen mixed vegetables; the mix varies by brand.

name: Frozen spinach
usdaDescription: Spinach, frozen, chopped or leaf, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
basis: Frozen unprepared weight; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Frozen spinach, chopped or leaf, unprepared.

name: Frozen peas
usdaDescription: Peas, green, frozen, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
basis: Frozen unprepared weight; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Frozen green peas, unprepared.

name: Frozen broccoli
usdaDescription: Broccoli, frozen, chopped, unprepared
basis: Frozen unprepared weight; cook before eating
nutritionNote: Frozen chopped broccoli, unprepared.

name: Canned tomatoes
usdaDescription: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice
nutritionNote: Red ripe tomatoes packed in tomato juice; includes the liquid.

name: Vegetable oil
usdaDescription: Oil, soybean, salad or cooking
nutritionNote: Soybean cooking oil represents generic vegetable oil. Different blends may differ.

name: Ice cream (vanilla)
usdaDescription: Ice creams, vanilla
basis: Ready to eat; weigh in grams, not mL
nutritionNote: Generic vanilla ice cream. Pack size and price are app estimates, not a store product.
